name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
summary: Point a coding agent at a much better workhorse for the same $0.75 per million input tokens as 3.7 Flash. Terminal-Bench jumps from 81.6% to 90.8%. Available now in AI Studio and the Gemini API.

name: Google Pics
summary: Make posters, flyers, and social graphics by describing them at pics.new, then tap any object in the image to change just that part. Text inside an image can be edited or translated into 29 languages.

name: Claude Fable 5.1
summary: Run longer coding and agent sessions for about 25% less than Fable 5 — up to 45% on agentic work, thanks to a 75% cut in cache-read pricing. One million tokens of context, 128K output per response.

name: Hybrid Compute on Mac
summary: Let a cloud agent do the thinking while your private files stay on your Mac — a local model handles them behind an on-device privacy gate. Needs Apple silicon, 24GB of memory, and a Pro or Max plan.

name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp
summary: Download a vision model that reads screenshots, charts, and documents, with MIT weights you can host or resell with no strings. First multimodal release in the V4 family.

name: OpenClaw 2.0
summary: Run an open-source agent that sets itself up from what you already have — a ChatGPT or Claude subscription, API keys, or local models. The rebuilt browser app does setup by conversation.

name: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash
summary: Stretch a generated clip out to 40 seconds in ten-second chunks, pin the first and last frames to storyboard a shot, then upscale to 4K. Draft at 360p for $0.03 a second first.

name: GLM-5.3-Flash
summary: Run a frontier-grade coding and agent model yourself — MIT-licensed weights on Hugging Face, a 1M-token context, image and video input. Or call the hosted API at a tenth of the previous GLM's price.
